## ef4af8761400

**Source bound:** generator SHA-256
`a5ccd3a38c1ca627ee8207100338eb1ed42b6e657f29363d9675bfe36fd6364b`.
**Assessment:** concrete canonical-fitting shortcut plus contract defects; no edit.

A strong rival is:

> Reflect only color-1 sources strictly above and left of the color-2 pivot;
> leave sources in the other three quadrants unchanged.

Every source cell in all five labeled canonical pairs is strictly upper-left of
the pivot, so this rival matches every canonical label. The production source
also constructs offsets as `pr-a, pc-b` with `a,b >= 1`. A source-bound census of
100 examples in each difficulty found 300/300 with all sources upper-left and the
rival fitting the intended transform on all 300.

Exact lawful counterexample (9x9): pivot 2 at `(4,4)`, source 1 at `(6,6)`, all
other cells zero. `self_check` returns `[]`. Canonical Racket paints color 1 at
`(2,2)`, `(2,6)`, `(6,2)`, and `(6,6)` while retaining the pivot. The rival leaves
only the original lower-right source. The local intended output exactly matches
the Racket receipt, whose executed/catalog rule hash is `ee95142401db`.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-quadrant-shortcut/input.json`
- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-quadrant-shortcut/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-quadrant-shortcut/rival_output.json`
- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-quadrant-shortcut/probe.json`

The audit preset also found no task tests and no semantic contract. Defect lint
reported 192 strict-scalar findings, dead/overlapping texture declarations and a
rule-source-divergence warning. Override checking produced 54,192+ findings,
principally because `grid_h`, `grid_w`, and `blob_size` bypass keyed provenance;
`palette_size` and `n_distinct_colors` are singleton pseudo-axes. Reports:

- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-combined/result.json`
- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-defect-lint/result.json`
- `checks/audit/ef4af8761400-override/result.json`

The finite 300-example sample is not needed to infer the structural restriction;
the generator source itself always emits upper-left sources. The sample and
canonical census quantify how completely the shortcut survives current teaching.
